description: OID_ECDSA_P256_SHA256 and OID_SHA256_WITH_RSA are gated #[cfg(any(feature = "p256", feature = "rsa"))]. EcdsaP256Verifier is gated #[cfg(feature = "p256")] only. If only feature=p256 is active OID_ECDSA_P256_SHA256 is visible but if only feature=rsa is active OID_ECDSA_P256_SHA256 is still compiled (due to the 'any'). The deeper problem: EcdsaP256Verifier's local OID const and OID_ECDSA_P256_SHA256 are independently defined strings; if the local const in the verifier were replaced by a reference to the module-level const, the gating must match exactly. The current independent-definition approach avoids the gating mismatch but introduces the duplication risk filed in PKIX-841.20.
notes: Re-examined: cfg gating is not broken. Both OIDs compile when either backend is active, which is correct. The real issue is duplication risk already filed in PKIX-841.20. This issue overlaps with PKIX-841.20.
title: DUPLICATE of PKIX-841.20: OID cfg gating analysis (not a real issue)
